name: remix_camera_companion_image
label: Remix.Camera Companion Image
description: Preview or generate Remix.Camera companion images from a Voiceflow playbook or workflow.

inputVariables.name: bridgeUrl
inputVariables.description: Public HTTPS Remix.Camera bridge URL. Use a secure tunnel for local testing.

inputVariables.name: command
inputVariables.description: Image command such as send-selfie, daily-life-snap, couple-photo, or private-snap.

inputVariables.name: action
inputVariables.description: Use dry-run for previews. Use generate only after explicit user confirmation.

inputVariables.name: yes
inputVariables.description: Must be true before the bridge spends Remix.Camera generation credits.

inputVariables.name: prompt
inputVariables.description: Recent chat context or user request.

inputVariables.name: sourceImageUrl
inputVariables.description: Optional source image URL for outfit or scene remixes.

inputVariables.name: userReferenceImageUrl
inputVariables.description: Optional user-owned reference photo URL for couple images.

inputVariables.name: userConsent
inputVariables.description: Required consent text for couple and multi-person image commands.

inputVariables.name: matureContent
inputVariables.description: True only for opted-in mature/private snap flows.

guardrails: Only set action to generate when the user explicitly asked for a real generated image.
Only set yes to true for generate actions.
For Voiceflow Cloud, bridgeUrl must be reachable over HTTPS.
